title: Telemetry
review: This is a masterclass in constrained storytelling. The telemetry format transforms raw data into narrative — velocity spikes become panic, prolonged stillness becomes dread, a 2-meter displacement becomes heartbreak. The clinical annotations ("possible repositioning inside shelter or limited mobility") achieve a devastating effect precisely because they cannot name what they're observing. The final entry's shift to rescue team voice, still maintaining the format, delivers the story's horror in a single detail: tracks terminating at an ice shelf overlook, no second set observed. Every number has been chosen with precision — the battery drain, the bearing changes during the descent, the 10-hour gap before the emergency flag. This doesn't just use its constraint; it makes the constraint inseparable from the meaning. A worthy opening piece for the portfolio.
